justifications.text: Checks the version of Warframe Market's public item catalog, to download the catalog again only when it changed.
Downloads Warframe Market's public catalog of PC items, to search items by name.
Loads the online sellers and buyers of the item you open.
Keeps the item catalog between games, so that a search does not download it again.
Copies the trade whisper of the order you click, to paste it in the game's chat.
